api_checks.description: F219 Owner and every staff role can open an uploaded file with the right type and safe headers: token of the owner and of analyst1, officer1 and admin1; body equals the uploaded bytes; Content-Type application/pdf; X-Content-Type-Options nosniff; Cache-Control no-store. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_document_file_api.py and e2e/live/ui-zdocuments.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.

F220 Other customers, anonymous callers and unknown documents are refused: token of a different customer; no token is 401; unknown document id or another case's document is 404. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_document_file_api.py and e2e/live/ui-zdocuments.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.

F222 Replaced versions are listed in the evidence and stay openable by staff: analyst token after a re-upload; documents contains both versions and the replaced one has superseded true. Evidence: backend/tests/integration/test_document_file_api.py and e2e/live/ui-zdocuments.live.ts. Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8010.
